english: Ngh... nngh? Where... is this...?
Oh, good morning.
You!? I won't let you escape!!
Too bad~.\nIf your charge had been 3 seconds faster,\nyou might've caught me?
What do you mean!
Know where this is?\nTake a look over there?
What...?
//Background: Kyoto\n//A youkai passes by
//Background: Forest
Get it now?
Am I dreaming...? Yes!\nThat must be it!
If it's a dream, you don't need to catch me.
Dream or not, a thief is a thief!\n...Ah!? Where's my Uchigane!?
That thing's too lame for me.\nIf it'd been Blue Tears, maybe.\nDon't want it!
Shut up! Where is this!?\nWhat did you do to me?
So many questions~. Let's make a deal.\nTell me about IS. Then I'll answer\nyour questions too.
A deal!? There's nothing I'd tell a thief!
Don't be so stiff~.\nWith such a nice body,\nno boy will like you acting like that?
M-mind your own business!!
Sorry sorry.\nAs a freebie, I'll tell you\none good thing.
This world is pretty dangerous. Better not\nwander around knowing nothing, okay?
Mmph...
IS don't have infinite energy, right? And since\na person pilots them, fighting forever\nis impossible, right?
(I don't care if I fight here and die.\nBut this Uchigane belongs to IS Academy.\nEven if I have to eat dirt, I must return alive...!!)
Deal?
//Fade to black - time passes
...That's about all I can tell you.\nThere's much about IS I don't know either.
Hmm. I knew you need aptitude to operate IS,\nbut even with aptitude, someone else\ncan't use a personal unit?
They're fully customized for one person.\nEven if you got Blue Tears,\nyou could never use it.
Won't know till I analyze the core, y'know?
Analyze it? Impossible. Only one person\nin the world can make cores.
Your sister, Dr. Tabane Shinonono, right?\nWith facilities and a fitting genius,\nI think analysis is doable.
You've got connections to a research institute?
No comment.
...Fine.\nNow it's your turn to talk.\nWhat is this place?
It's written "mirror capital"\nand read "Kyoto."\nIt's full of youkai - like a giant haunted house!
That just sounds like you're messing with me?
I'm serious.\nAnd there's stuff scarier\nthan youkai here too?
So, why did you come here?
Can't tell you that one~.\nLet's just say I can't take Houkin along -\nread between the lines.
Who's "Houkin"!?
Kufufu! This is goodbye.\nI can't walk you home,\nbut if you're lucky you might make it back? Bye-bye!
...Next time we meet, we're enemies.
If you get strong enough to call an enemy,\nI'll invite you to join me. Kufu!
Mine... Riko, huh.
//Background: Kyoto\n//SE: a dramatic "dun-duuun"-like sting
Uhh... w-wha... huh!?\nWh-what am I supposed to do... here...?
Eek!? Th-there it is!!
Heh-heh! Today too I beat up\ntons of Shouko-chan's minions!\nMan, what a haul! What a haul!
Oh my, Koto. Lively as ever today.
Yase! Sorry 'bout the ruckus again today too!
It's fine.\nEvery day's like a festival - it's fun, isn't it?
Oh yeah, folks were saying evil spirits are showing up or whatever -\nwant me to go smash 'em?
That's grown-up work.\nA kid's job is to play, right?
Right!? Then I'm off to raise some more hell!
She really is adorable...
Alright! Wonder if there's anything fun going on!\nLet's go find it!!
...though, Kyouto's pretty peaceful.\nThe only one who'll play with me\nis Shouko-chan.
Eek!? Th-there it is!!
Hm? What was that voice just now?\nIt's coming from Yase's off-limits area!
Y-you monsters! H-hey, stay back!
Eek!?
Hey lady, whatcha doing?\nCount me in!
Count you in!? On what!?
I know! Wanna bet on\nwho can smash more youkai?
What could a child like you possibly do!?
I'm not a kid. I'm Koto!\nWhat's your name, lady?
Shinonono Houki! Now just run!
Just watch! I'm super tough!
Huh? Guess I didn't connect clean?
(So THIS is the thing more terrifying than youkai\nthat Riko was talking about...!?)
Okay, warm-up's done!\nLet's get started!
...A-alright!
Nyo~...
Hm? Who's there!?
A zashiki-warashi, maybe?
You saw me... Those who see me die, nyo...!
It's saying something pretty menacing!?
Then how about that one's worth\n2 points if we beat it?
What IS it with your carefree attitude... I don't get it.
Nyo~...
It got away! Wait up!!
Hey! You're going after it!?
Obviously!\nYou're coming too, Houki-san! C'mon!
Mm... Fine, come what may!
Whoa, we really ended up somewhere else!\nThat's super handy!
We've been hurled to some unknown place, and 'handy'\nis the word that comes to your lips?\nI cannot comprehend your nerves...
Might Houki-san be here?
Like anything'd be that convenient!
Dunno?\nShe might be around here eating a bento or something!
Ah... Come to think of it, I don't think\nbentos have ever shown up in this shoot...
Everyone, quiet! I sense something nasty...
Gyaah!? What're these!?
Oh my, what are these?
Cecilia-chan, you're fine with this kinda stuff?
Brits have bad taste.
That is prejudice!
That's riiight!\nTh-this is... super loooovely!
Huh?
Huh?
W-whoa, amazing CG tech!?
Huh!?
Don't let your guard down! We're being targeted!
(Good thing we transformed, Aoi-chan)
(Yes, Haruka-san)
Evil spirits, bring it on!\nI'll hit you with my magical magic!
Whoa! Cool!
I'll take point! Follow me!
Hold it! The enemy's strength is unknown.\nI'll go first with Kouryuu!
Butt out!
I know you're quick on your feet.\nBut IS armor's got better defense, right?
...Roger, I'll cover you.
Having Aria cover me is reassuring.\nCecilia! Bits are a solo weapon, so\nyou run interference!
Against that level of rabble,\nI alone am more than enough!
Even at training level,\nhaving seasoned fighters around is reassuring.
You said it.
S-sorry I'm not used to this...
I need to learn from them too...!
Let's go!
Leave it to meeee!!
Um, they don't go down in number even when we beat them...
As expected of cutting-edge tech!
At this rate we'll just get worn down.\nWhat do we do...?
Hmm...
Lalala~
Is that one a youkai too?\nA youkai bunny-eared girl... was that ever a thing?
Kiii! I'm NOT a youkai!
It talked!?
Of course I talk!!
Youkai legion, finish them off!
So it WAS the youkai boss!?
Urgh, I got carried away\nand picked a needless fight!\nFine then... Go! Night Parade of a Hundred Demons!!
Wh-what!? Are you insane!?
Just looking at that many makes me sick...
If there are that many,\ntaking one home wouldn't get noticed,\nright? Right? Riiight?
I have my doubts about that...
A grand vanishing magic to wipe them all out!\nHow about that?
Even if that worked, someone'd have to\nclean up after it somewhere...
This is no time for jokes!\nFighting that many is just a waste!
Agreed, let's run!
Cecilia, we're the rear guard!
Understood!
Everyone's okay... Honestly,\nI never thought we'd get sent straight to\nsome haunted-house-looking place!
You'll get used to it.\nI barely get surprised by anything anymore.
Still, I think this world deserves\na little more surprise.\nLike something's fundamentally off.
M-maybe... the backgrounds are all CG too!?
Really!?\nThat's amazing, Aoi-chan!
Haruka-san, everyone was fighting normally,\nso I don't think it was CG?
Oh, right.
We'll have to look into a lot of things.\nAnd I'm worried whether Houki-san\nis even here.
Lost her, huh.
What is this about?\nIs there some reason we had to\nchase that thing?
Yeah. I thought maybe\nit knows something\nabout the rabbit.
Rabbit? You mean that long-eared thing?
Probably... I don't really get it either,\nbut I was told to find the rabbit. A black rabbit.
A black rabbit? Whatever for?
That's... oh, before that, Houki-san,\nwanna stop by my place?\nI'm starving!
I don't mind.\nI've nowhere else to go anyway.
Really?\nThen let's eat together!\nMy place is this way!
Good grief, this got strange...\nStill, better than wandering\nthis shady place alone...
Sis. That just now...
That\nis none of our concern.\nLet's go, Nacchan.
...Understood.
Mmm, delicious... The garden,\nthe tea, all to my liking. What a lovely afternoon...
And who are yooou,\nruining such a lovely afternoon?
Pleased to make your acquaintance, Yase-douji.\nI am Tesura Violet.\nThis is my younger sister...
...Nain Violet.
No solicitors.
No, I've merely come to pay my respects.
State your business.\nIt's not nothing, is it?
Once our business is done,\nwe will promptly leave Kyouto.\nI came only to tell you that.
...I don't understand what you're saying?
I mean nothing by it.
If anything comes up, please contact\nthe cell number on my business card.\nI bought it here, so it should work.
...Goodbye.
...How stupid.\nWhat could outsiders possibly do?
I don't know where you came from,\nbut no one ever leaves Kyouto...
//END
